notes: DestroyVoxEngine: deletes the singleton through its destructor and VoxFree. Partial: the destructor calls Shutdown, which needs the VoxThread destructor (not defined)
Shutdown: destroys the emitter thread then the source thread. Partial: VoxThread destructor not defined
D1: Shutdown, engine object destroyed and freed, mutex destroyed and freed. Partial: Shutdown (VoxThread destructor) and VoxEngineInternal destructor not defined
D0 deleting destructor: compiler-generated (delete provides it). Wraps D1, which is partial
D2: same body as D1 (complete-object destructor). Partial, see D1
C1 constructor: mutex allocated and constructed, engine object taken from VoxEngineInternal::GetVoxEngineInternal; timestamps and thread slots zeroed
GetVoxEngine: returns the singleton, or allocates and constructs it on first use
C2 constructor: same body as C1

UpdateEmittersThreaded (instance): samples the clock, computes dt from the previous stamp, never moves the stamp back, calls UpdateEmitters(dt). Partial: VoxEngineInternal::UpdateEmitters not defined; clock and dt helpers are inferred
UpdateThreaded: UpdateSourcesThreaded then UpdateEmittersThreaded. Partial: the callees need VoxEngineInternal::UpdateSources and UpdateEmitters, not defined
Thunk: 4-byte jump to 0x862cf0 (UpdateThreaded, instance). Not reimplemented; the port calls the instance method directly

Thunk: 4-byte jump to 0x862c4c (UpdateEmittersThreaded, instance). Not reimplemented. Its thread-callback role is covered by the static overload in engine_instance.cpp that Initialize passes to VoxThread

Initialize: calls the engine Initialize, registers the stream factories (memory buffer, C file) and decoder factories (raw, MSWav, stb_vorbis, MPC8, native, then null) in listing order, starts the emitter and source threads, records the start time. Partial: VoxThread constructor, and the MSWav, MPC8 and Native factories, are not defined; the listing returns the low word of the time, which the port does not carry

PriorityBankManager::Update: for each bank drops entries whose emitter is not playing (clears its bank flag). Null entries are never inserted (AddEmitter refuses null), so the listing null-exit path is not exercised. Return value is the mutex unlock result, not carried (void port)

PriorityBankManager::AddEmitter: refusal gates, append for behaviour 3 or room under max, behaviour 0 evicts the first entry, behaviours 1 and 2 evict by priority. Partial: EmitterObj::Stop is not defined (eviction stops the victim); the writer of EmitterObj priority_ (+0x2c) is not identified. The port guards the empty-bank case of behaviour 0 that the listing dereferences

VoxUtils::LoadDataSourceFromFileToRAM: opens the file, sizes it, reads it into a VoxAlloc buffer, closes it, hands the buffer to the engine as a RAM source; empty handle on any failure before the hand-off. Partial: the listing read call has no count argument (port passes the remaining bytes); the engine load call drops the engine and sixth arguments

VoxUtils::LoadDataSourceFromFile: engine path load (kind 1) with the format. Partial: VoxEngine::LoadDataSource is declared on a static facade whose body waits on VoxEngineInternal::LoadDataSource; the sixth argument is dropped

VoxUtils::LoadDataSourceFromFileAsRAW: loads through LoadDataSourceFromFile then converts. Partial: in the listing the convert call takes the engine singleton where the loaded handle appears expected; the port converts the loaded handle (unconfirmed)
VoxUtils::LoadDataSourceFromFileEx: routes by load flags (0x10000 async, bit 0 RAM, value 2 RAW, else file). Partial: async call drops the sixth argument and the user value; the dispatch is complete

VoxUtils::LoadDataSourceFromFileAutoDetectDecoder: picks the decoder from the extension (wav 1, ogg 2, mpc 3, vxn 4), else empty handle. Dispatch is complete; the load goes through the partial LoadDataSourceFromFile
VoxUtils::LoadDataSourceFromFileAutoDetectDecoderEx: as AutoDetectDecoder through LoadDataSourceFromFileEx with load flags and user value. Dispatch is complete; the load goes through the partial Ex
